ITEM 1 | Pale green leafy vegetable (crisp, ruffled lettuce-like leaves with darker green edges and pale yellow-white inner leaves), tossed with a creamy off-white dressing coating the leaves; scattered shaved pale cheese shards and small toasted crumbs on top; sits on the left third of the plate, spreading about 9 cm by 8 cm and roughly 3 cm tall at the mound's peak | 110

ITEM 2 | Creamy off-white dressing or sauce coating the leafy greens, glossy and thick, pooled slightly at the base of the greens near the plate's left-center | 25

ITEM 3 | Baked pasta square of layered sheets with red-orange tomato sauce and golden-brown cheese on top; edges browned and slightly crisp, cheese bubbled and blistered with light char spots; occupies the upper-right area about 11 cm by 9 cm and about 3 cm thick, sitting beside the greens | 230

ITEM 4 | Red-orange tomato sauce visible along the upper edge of the baked pasta, glossy and moist, spread thinly around the pasta's top-left border | 20

ITEM 5 | Stuffed or rolled item with a smooth, pinkish-orange baked exterior, slightly glossy with browned patches, a fresh green herb leaf stuck on one end; cut edge shows a moist, soft, pale interior; sits in the lower-center of the plate, about 7 cm by 4 cm and about 3 cm tall | 130

ITEM 6 | Scattered small golden-brown toasted crumbs and bits, dry and crisp, sprinkled between the greens and the pasta and near the rolled item | 5
